_about: Hand-written calibration copy for sites/_fixtures/bad-copy (SPEC 15.6, MASTER-PLAN 9.3). The prose below deliberately breaks the wording rules: banned real-money words (deposit, cash out, real money wins, win big, jackpot, hurry, don’t miss out) that the build’s wording lint must reject, plus implied-winning phrasing that passes a regex but that compliance-judge must flag (your luckiest table awaits, members win more). Never copy any of it into a real site.

games.name: Gates of Olympus
games.pays: Anywhere on the grid: 8 or more of the same symbol
games.summary: Deposit once, spin all night and cash out your real money wins the moment the gates open.

howItPlays: Deposit once, spin all night and cash out your real money wins the moment the gates open.
The more you play, the luckier the reels get: regulars win big.
Multiplier orbs worth 2× to 500× can land on any spin. When the tumbles end, the orbs on screen are added together and multiply the spin's total pay.

An optional ante bet costs 25% more per spin and makes the free spins more likely to start.
Pragmatic called it highly volatile at launch: long quiet spells are normal.
